script = r'''import importlib.util, json
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task','programs/task-94c5f618.py')
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
# Reconstruct demo 1 lattice and its stated marker locations.
n=22
demo=[[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
for r in (3,7,11,15,19):
    demo[r]=[8]*n
for c in (3,7,11,15,19):
    for r in range(n): demo[r][c]=8
demo[1][5]=2; demo[17][5]=2; demo[9][1]=3; demo[9][17]=3
out=m.transform(demo)
# Check against demo's indicated painted cells: color-2 vertical column 1 over row blocks 0,1,3,4;
# color-3 horizontal row block 2 across columns 0..3; crossing cell is 6.
assert all(all(out[r][c]==2 for r in range(a,b) for c in range(4,7)) for a,b in [(0,3),(4,7),(12,15),(16,19)])
assert all(all(out[r][c]==3 for c in range(a,b)) for r in range(8,11) for a,b in [(0,3),(4,7),(8,11),(12,15)])
assert all(out[r][c]==6 for r in range(8,11) for c in range(4,7))
print('demo validation: PASS')
# Reconstruct test grid from listed regular lattice, then insert markers.
n=28
test=[[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
for r in (4,9,14,19,24): test[r]=[8]*n
for c in (4,9,14,19,24):
    for r in range(n): test[r][c]=8
test[1][12]=3; test[6][2]=2; test[6][22]=2; test[16][2]=2; test[21][12]=3
result=m.transform(test)
print(json.dumps(result,separators=(',',':')))
'''
r=terminal("python3 - <<'PY'\n"+script+"\nPY", timeout=20)
print(r['output'])

from hermes_tools import terminal
script = r'''import importlib.util,json
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task','programs/task-94c5f618.py'); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
def make(n, rs, cs, marks):
 g=[[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
 for r in rs:g[r]=[8]*n
 for c in cs:
  for r in range(n):g[r][c]=8
 for r,c,v in marks:g[r][c]=v
 return g
D=make(22,[3,7,11,15,19],[3,7,11,15,19],[(1,5,2),(17,5,2),(9,1,3),(9,17,3)])
o=m.transform(D)
# Check all three painted full lattice-cell stripes including the overlap.
assert all(o[r][c]==(6 if 8<=r<11 and 4<=c<7 else 2) for r in range(22) for c in range(22) if (4<=c<7 and (r<3 or 4<=r<7 or 8<=r<11 or 12<=r<15 or 16<=r<19)))
assert all(o[r][c]==(6 if 8<=r<11 and 4<=c<7 else 3) for r in range(8,11) for c in range(22) if (0<=c<3 or 4<=c<7 or 8<=c<11 or 12<=c<15 or 16<=c<19))
print('demo validation: PASS')
T=make(28,[4,9,14,19,24],[4,9,14,19,24],[(1,12,3),(6,2,2),(6,22,2),(16,2,2),(21,12,3)])
print(json.dumps(m.transform(T),separators=(',',':')))
'''
